# Additional Modality Worklist queries

Queries written for dicom-go (not taken from DCMTK) in the dump format of
DCMTK's `dcmwlm/data/wlistqry` examples. They run against DCMTK's example
worklist database (`testdata/upstream/dcmtk/wlistdb`) together with DCMTK's
own queries, so matching on multi-valued, range and wildcard keys is compared
with DCMTK wlmscpfs as well. They contain no patient data.
